verdict: Lead cost dropped sharply, but several setup milestones need to close first.
narrative: Over the last 28 days your cost per lead fell 51% week-over-week, driven by Meta delivering 50% more leads on lower spend — a genuine efficiency improvement. However, the tracked lead count in your CRM remains low at 6 for the period, so that cost-per-lead figure needs more volume behind it before we can scale confidently on it. The more pressing issue is that several agreed milestones — intake owner confirmation, the booking automation, the financing page, Homer Glen branch, and LSA heating re-enable — are all past their due dates and are currently blocking the scale-up step in your plan. We are working through those gates now so that when heating season campaigns go live October 1st, the full system is ready to handle the volume.
